author: ETA PRIME
description:
Today we're taking a look at the all-new GameSir G7 Pro 8K AimLabs Edition. This Pro controller works wired or wireless and features a massive 8000Hz polling rate for incredibly low latency. GameSir has packed this with their new TMR Gen 2 sticks so you never have to worry about stick drift, plus it includes locking triggers, optical switch face buttons, and swappable D-pads.
